@@U02533@@
“To whom it may concern, hereby be advised that this note is worth one thousand crowns, its collateral guaranteed by countless treasures lying buried in Imperial Lands. Plans are presently in motion to raise said treasure and with it redeem this note.”

@@U02535@@
What is this I suspect? Fraud? Some monstrous deception?

@@U02537@@
Consider, Sire! Remember! You signed it yourself, last night. There you were, dressed as Great Pan, and the Chancellor, in company with us, approached you and said: “Sign this note, Majesty, and with a few strokes of the pen crown this grand festivity with salvation for your people!” And sign it you did, Sire, and in the night our nimble conjurors ran off thousands. And to allow everyone without delay to share in the benefit, we at once stamped the whole series Tens, thirties, fifties, hundreds are now ready to hand. You can't imagine the pleasure your subjects feel! Take a look at your city. It was dead and rotting before, but now it’s alive and teeming with pleasure seekers! Your name has always meant happiness, but never has it been regarded with such devotion. The alphabet lost its value last night, for in this signature all men find happiness!
translation:
@@U02533@@
“对于相关人员，特此告知，这张纸币价值一千克朗，其抵押品是由埋藏在帝国土地上的无数宝藏担保的。目前正在制定筹集上述宝藏并用其赎回这张纸币的计划。”

@@U02535@@
我怀疑这是什么？欺诈罪？一些可怕的欺骗？

@@U02537@@
请考虑一下，陛下！记住！昨晚你自己签了字。你在那里，打扮成伟大的潘恩，财政大臣在我们的陪伴下，走近你说：“陛下，签署这张纸条，用笔轻轻几笔，为你的人民带来救赎，为这个盛大的节日加冕！”陛下，您签署了，一夜之间，我们敏捷的魔术师就消灭了数千人。为了让每个人都能立即分享利益，我们立即在整个系列上盖章，十，三十，五十，数百现在已准备就绪。你无法想象你的拍摄对象感受到的快乐！看看你所在的城市。以前它已经死了、腐烂了，但现在却又活过来了，充满了寻欢作乐的人！你的名字一直意味着幸福，但从未被如此虔诚地对待。字母表昨晚失去了它的价值，因为在这个签名中，所有的人都找到了幸福！
